Her complete documented species set is Alakazam, Bronzong, Gallade, Golurk, Gothitelle, Metagross, Munna, Musharna, Reuniclus, Sableye, Sigilyph, Zekrom — i.e. the BW/B2W2 Elite Four teams and rematches, Masters EX (Reuniclus and Mega Sableye — which do count, and are already_verified via Solosis/Sableye), and Pokémon Adventures (Gothitelle, her 'only known Pokémon' in the manga). The Darach angle does not rescue it either: Darach's page has zero Pawniard/Bisharp hits, and the Battle Castle he fights in on her behalf is Generation IV (Platinum/HGSS), where Pawniard — a Generation V species — cannot appear, so this is not a 'battles on her behalf' case at all. Bisharp is the Unova Elite Four Pokémon of GRIMSLEY, her E4 colleague; this is another trainer's Pokémon that leaked in from a same-Elite-Four pass.
